test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In April 2022, Chief Justice of India NV Ramana recommended the creation of an “independent umbrella institution”, so as to bring various agencies under one roof”. Which of the following agencies did he suggest be brought under this umbrella?
solution:
The correct answer is __**ED, CBI and SFIO**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In April 2022, Chief Justice of India NV Ramana recommended the creation of an "independent umbrella institution" to bring various agencies under one roof.
 
• He suggested that the **ED, CBI, and SFIO** be brought under this umbrella institution.
 
• This recommendation aims to ensure better coordination and efficiency among these agencies.
 
• Such a move is expected to help in tackling complex and high-profile cases more effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI)** is the premier investigating agency of India.
 
• **Serious Fraud Investigation Office (SFIO)** is a multidisciplinary organization to investigate serious financial frauds.
 
• **Enforcement Directorate (ED)** is a specialized financial investigation agency under the Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance.
 
• These agencies play a crucial role in maintaining financial and legal order in the country.
